Of all the Dunkin' branches in Davao, this branch is the worst! They have a lot of staff but they don't seem to care if there are many customers waiting in front, you call them "excuse me" instead of turning away, AVOIDING EYE CONTACT, they are deaf and dumb for what? To avoid customers? Even if we are in line in front, they will approach the new arrivals... They don't even ask who is in line first, it's common sense that you should approach those who are already in line, I've tried coming here many times but the same thing happens, I hear some customers complaining why it takes so long because there are so many people inside. Some just leave, in other Dunkin' branches there are only two staff but they are very attentive, but why can't they do it here in Ecoland. You can't even say that you are busy, because JCO has a longer line and more customers but their service is smooth from ordering to paying. Try to visit Dunkin sm Ecoland and inotice their service
